prompt: The acorn spec for rate limiting in candles is done (issue #18, quick mode). Can you review it and if it looks good, walk me through getting implementation started?

assertions.text: Performs a structured review before discussing implementation
Calibrates review expectations to quick mode (doesn't penalize for missing red team analysis)
After review, shows the user the handoff commands (acorn approve, dev wt, dev pi)
Includes the spec path so the implementer knows where to find it
Lets the user control the handoff pace — doesn't auto-run commands
Includes review notes or implementation guidance for the agent
Mentions how to check agent progress (dev pi-status)
